what: Video and photo cells inside a circle flow endlessly to the left at 30px per second with 270px spacing, and each cell grows the farther it is from the board center (center 212px → both ends 336px, proportional to the square of the distance) — a string of beads that shrinks concavely in the middle. It rests when the board is off-screen, and with reduced motion set it stays still and only fits the sizes.

options.speed: Flow speed (px/s), default 30 — 0 keeps it still and only changes size
options.grow: Share that grows larger at both ends, default .585 (212→336px) — 0 keeps the size as is
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Flowing rounded slots (video/photo) — fx.js attaches one more set

note: The original is a Framer marquee part, so the speed was estimated by eye from movement between screen captures. Size ratio measured on the first screen (center 212 · end 336px)

from.where: index.html .dv-orbs (five round orbs in the Hero — 3D video)
